name: MT-Bench_Evaluated
description: An evaluated collection around MT-Bench that assesses conversational AI assistants on multi-turn instruction-following and dialogue scenarios using human judgments. The dataset records pairwise comparisons and rated criteria (helpfulness, honesty, harmlessness) to compare model responses across diverse chat prompts.
evaluation_method: human_eval (pairwise preference / scoring on multiple criteria)
general_score_metric: human preference score / win rate (paired comparisons)
reputation: MT-Bench is a widely cited, influential human-evaluation benchmark for chat assistants and is commonly used in LLM/assistant comparisons.
